# Opes Consulting

> Opes Consulting is an eCRM and lifecycle email marketing agency based in London, working with B2B, B2C and eCommerce brands across the UK, Europe and the USA. We build email marketing programmes, CRM automation, N8N workflow automation and custom websites. Work is backed by a guarantee: you don't pay unless we deliver on the Performance Threshold agreed in writing before any work starts.

Platforms we work in: Klaviyo, HubSpot, Brevo, GoHighLevel, N8N. Contact: hello@opesconsulting.online. Instagram: @weareopes.

- [Pricing](https://opesconsulting.london/pricing): modules from $500, bundles from $4,700 (Pipeline, Loyalty and Revenue), retainers from $299 a month, custom projects quoted, and how the guarantee works

- [Free resource](https://opesconsulting.london/free-resource): the lifecycle email blueprint, with 9 flows, 43 emails and 18 campaign types
